headline: Tate’s New Director Knows Its Glory Days. Can She Bring Them Back?
context: Jessica Morgan was at Tate before Brexit, the pandemic and steep cuts to the arts. Her work at Dia Art Foundation since then suggests that she is an optimistic appointment for the British museum group.
